one_line_pitch_to_sam: It's a grey parking lot where you find a sword by mashing keys, kill your friend so they do this hilarious roll-over death, and jump off a tower flapping your arms, but it's silent and there's nothing else to do.

moments.why: Spawning itself was nothing, but getting spawn camped before the sword was out stuck with Robin as unfair.
Running around was just how you got places.
A few jumps at spawn that led to nothing.
Crouching was slow and there was nobody to hide from.
Kai remembers winning the race up, but mostly as the way to the jump, and the top had nothing.
Flailing arms on a counted-down jump together was the biggest shared laugh.
Remembered only as 'the pool's nothing'; the swim animation itself is forgotten.
Sitting on a bench was a few seconds of goofing with no payoff.
Punching air was instantly overwritten by punching Robin.
Hitting the dummy gave no feedback, so only its pointless death is recalled.
The punch combo was exciting for a minute and then the sword replaced it.
Kick was one more button found by mashing and never used again after the sword.
Holding F is remembered only as the setup for the 'blocking is broken' argument.
Pressing 1 and a sword appearing was Kai's biggest surprise of the night.
Sword does huge damage and was how every kill happened, though they remember it being silent.
Dummy gives nothing and just comes back, so it's one dismissive line.
The first punch making a health bar appear was the moment the game started.
The roll-over death made Robin laugh every time and is the score Kai is still arguing about.
Hitting a blocker looked like lag; it's remembered as broken, and funny only because Robin lied about it.
Waving at a dummy that ignores you was a tiny giggle that didn't last.
Dancing alone in a silent 'parking lot' was a funny image Robin made into a story.
Salute, laugh, cheer, clap and point each played once and felt like ticking boxes.
No dab and silently failing emotes made it seem like chat was broken.
The dance cutting off when hit wasn't noticed as its own thing.
The dummy just standing there breathing is forgotten; only that you can beat it up remains.
Running for a minute into endless grey was the most boring part and sticks as proof the game is empty.
No score, menu or goal is the main reason they quit and why Kai says no for now.
